## Progress

- Merged [PR #86](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/86): PATIENT_RELATIONSHIP (`patients.Relationships`, name and phone masked, EF filter + RLS, cross-tenant test); emergency contact required for full registration, optional in quick mode and the third part the completion task waits for; guardian required whenever the patient is under 18 on the registration day in the facility's time zone (IFacilityDirectory), quick mode included; an estimated date of birth is never treated as known (the stated age decides; unknown counts as a minor); relationship values per country (UAE adds Sponsor); contacts never become users (no account or membership created, tested); Family & emergency step with the portal note, guardian fields in quick mode for a minor, contacts on the record and the completion form; SAFETY tests on the server mutation-checked (rule removed, quick-mode exemption, country day instead of facility day, unknown age as adult, 18th birthday off by one); en/hi/ar, axe clean
- Follow-ups outside this ticket: guardian-driven portal proxy rules (P4 R-04)

## Description

PATIENT_RELATIONSHIP: emergency contact name, relationship, phone (required for full registration), guardian (required when age < 18; UAE: guardian/sponsor for dependants). Note shown: emergency contacts get no portal access; caregiver access is via patient-authorised proxy (P4 R-04).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** When DOB indicates age < 18, guardian becomes required and save is blocked without it.
- [ ] **AC2.** Emergency contact is required for full registration but not for quick registration.
- [ ] **AC3.** Emergency contacts never receive portal access or patient data (no account is created).
- [ ] **AC4.** Relationship values are country-specific (UAE includes Sponsor).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
